products.body_html: Your back carries everything. The Duroflex Neuma Roller Back Massager is built to unload it. Gliding and single-point Shiatsu massage with heat therapy works through tension across the back in a pre-programmed 15-minute session. Portable, travel-ready, and USB-C fast charging, so you can experience consistent relief wherever you are.

products.title: Neuma Ottoman Thermo Leg Massager
products.body_html: Your feet carry you through everything, and rarely get the rest they deserve. The Duroflex Neuma Ottoman Leg Massager delivers Shiatsu, rolling, and compression massage with heat therapy, targeting fatigue and tension from sole to calf in one complete session. Adjustable intensity puts you in control of your relief. When not in use, it doubles as a stylish ottoman for your living room.

products.title: Neuma Thermo Neck Massager Pillow
products.body_html: Tension builds quietly through the day. The Duroflex Neuma Thermo Neck Massager Pillow melts it away in 10 minutes. 2D Shiatsu massage in gliding and single-point modes, paired with heat therapy, targets knots at the source for deeper, faster relief. Lightweight, travel-ready, and USB-C fast charging, it’s designed to fit effortlessly into your daily routine.

products.title: Energise 100% Latex Pillow
products.body_html:
<p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience a new level of comfort with the </span><strong>Duroflex Energise 100% Latex Pillow</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> — engineered for people who want cooling comfort, adaptive support, and healthier sleep.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Made from </span><strong>100% natural latex</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">, the pillow instantly adapts to your head and neck for perfect alignment and reduced pressure. The unique </span><strong>pincore ventilation design</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> improves airflow, preventing heat build-up and keeping you cool through the night. Wrapped in premium fabric, the pillow enhances temperature regulation, ensuring an undisturbed, refreshing sleep experience.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">With a </span><strong>medium-soft feel</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">, it relaxes your muscles, relieves neck strain, and maintains consistent comfort without sagging. Naturally </span><strong>hypoallergenic</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">, it resists dust mites, mould and fungus -making it a safe choice for adults, children, and sensitive sleepers.</span></p>

products.title: Dual Support Pillow
products.body_html:
The Duroflex Dual Support Pillow is designed to give you the best of both worlds. No matter your mood or sleep preference, this pillow adapts to your needs every night.
Crafted with high-quality Ice Dough™ Core, the Dual Support Pillow ensures proper alignment of your head, neck, and spine, helping reduce strain and stiffness for healthier sleep.
Its dual-sided design lets you sleep as you prefer i.e. Back or Side.
Wrapped in breathable Arctic IceTm Fabric, the pillow actively regulates temperature and enhances airflow, keeping you cool and fresh all night long. Built with durable materials, it resists sagging and retains its shape even with daily use, ensuring consistent comfort for years.
Whether you’re dealing with neck discomfort, restless nights, or simply looking for customizable comfort, the Duroflex Dual Support Pillow delivers a personalized sleep experience that adapts to you. Think of it as two pillows in one, made for restorative, restful sleep night after night.
tags: Cover Stitching Work From Home Pillow

products.title: Core balance Pillow
products.body_html:
The Duroflex Duropedic Core Balance Pillow is engineered for superior sleep. This medium-firm pillow is perfectly curated to a height of 4 inches for optimal neck support and tension relief.
Stay cool all night with our pillow's advanced open-cell Ice Dough™ technology and Arctic Ice™ outer fabric, designed to boost ventilation and absorb body heat. It adapts to your unique shape, providing versatile comfort whether you're a back, side, or stomach sleeper.
tags: Cover Stitching Work From Home Pillow

products.title: Spine Contour Pillow
products.body_html:
No more aches and pains! Our Duroflex Duropedic Spine Contour Pillow is built to give your neck and spine the optimal level of comfort. Its unique, elevated shape, featuring a dual height for maximum comfort, is perfect if you're dealing with neck pain, stiffness from poor posture, or even issues like cervical spondylosis.
Stay cool all night with our pillow's advanced open-cell Ice Dough™ technology and Arctic Ice™ outer fabric, designed to boost breathability and absorb body heat to give you a restorative sleep.
